content.title: How to watch Mets vs. Giants: TV channel and streaming options for April 2
content.text: The New York Mets visit the San Francisco Giants to start a four-game series at Oracle Park, with first pitch at 9:45 p.m. ET on Thursday. David Peterson (0-0, 0.00 ERA) will start for the Mets, who are 3-3 this season and third in the NL East.
